project.name: fiu
project.description: A Node.js TypeScript CLI that turns real code from a repository into small, verified practice exercises (Workouts) such as Drills, Katas, Predictions, What-ifs, and Diagnoses, to keep developers fluent in code they did not write.

nodes.name: drills.ts
nodes.summary: Agent mode for Fiu: lets the user's coding agent author Drills, Tracks, and Atlas entries while Fiu supplies prompts, verifies submissions through the Verified gate in the sandbox, and saves them.

nodes.name: AgentRequestError
nodes.summary: Error type signalling a refusal the calling coding agent should read and act on, as opposed to a Fiu bug.

nodes.name: AgentDrills
nodes.summary: Agent-mode service exposing prepare/submit operations for Drills, Tracks, and the Atlas; verifies agent-written Workouts with the same schema, Verified gate, and sandbox as Fiu's own generation.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Agent-mode Atlas tools: prepare_atlas hands the agent the next pending folder to describe, and submit_atlas checks and saves its entries.

nodes.name: prepareAtlas
nodes.summary: Returns the next folder in a directory's subtree that needs describing, with the prompt material needed to describe it.

nodes.name: submitAtlas
nodes.summary: Checks and saves one folder's agent-written Atlas entries and reports what remains pending in scope.

nodes.name: describe.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the model prompt for describing a folder's files in the Atlas, validates the model's structured output, and writes accepted descriptions into the Atlas keyed by content hash.

nodes.name: folderPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt for one describe call: subfolders, already-described files, and declarations plus key-function code for files to describe.

nodes.name: fileSection
nodes.summary: Formats one file's declarations and key-function code for the folder prompt.

nodes.name: checkAtlasOutput
nodes.summary: Lists problems with a model's or agent's description of a folder's files; empty when it can be saved.

nodes.name: applyAtlasOutput
nodes.summary: Saves a checked description into the Atlas, tied to the hashes of the content it describes.

nodes.name: describeFolder
nodes.summary: Runs one model call (with one retry on unusable output) describing some of a folder's files and optionally the folder itself.

nodes.name: links.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the Atlas's model-free links between files: import graphs for relative/TypeScript, Python, and Go imports plus git co-change history, cached in .fiu/links.json.

nodes.name: loadLinks
nodes.summary: Loads the Atlas's computed links (imports and co-change) between described files, caching them while HEAD and code stay unchanged.

nodes.name: importGraph
nodes.summary: Computes who imports whom among a set of files, dispatching on each profile's import style.

nodes.name: relativeImports
nodes.summary: Extracts relative import/export/require/dynamic-import targets from JS/TS source that resolve to known files.

nodes.name: pythonImports
nodes.summary: Resolves Python absolute and relative imports to repository files, trying src-layout and submodule fallbacks.

nodes.name: readGoModules
nodes.summary: Reads go.mod module paths in the repository for resolving Go package imports.

nodes.name: goImports
nodes.summary: Resolves Go package imports under the repository's modules to links to the package's folder files.

nodes.name: coChange
nodes.summary: Finds which files changed together in recent git history, excluding merges and mass commits.

nodes.name: overlay.ts
nodes.summary: Overlays Understand-Anything's knowledge-graph entries beneath Fiu's own Atlas, preferring current Fiu entries and keeping Fiu's entries intact when saving.

nodes.name: fromUa
nodes.summary: Whether an Atlas entry came from Understand-Anything.

nodes.name: uaEnabled
nodes.summary: Reports whether the Understand-Anything overlay is enabled by repository config, defaulting to on.

nodes.name: readAtlasOverlay
nodes.summary: Reads Fiu's Atlas with Understand-Anything's graph laid underneath when available and allowed.

nodes.name: overlayAtlas
nodes.summary: Pure merge where current Fiu entries win and UA entries fill missing or stale ones.

nodes.name: savable
nodes.summary: Restores Fiu's own entries hidden by UA entries so writing the build Atlas never loses Fiu's descriptions.

nodes.name: coveredByUa
nodes.summary: Counts files in scope needing no Fiu description because UA's entry is current.

nodes.name: uaNotice
nodes.summary: Builds a one-line notice saying UA's graph is in use or why it is not.

nodes.name: render.ts
nodes.summary: Renders the Atlas view (folders, files, key functions, and per-file links) as indented terminal text or a Markdown document for `fiu atlas`.

nodes.name: linkRows
nodes.summary: Builds one file's links as label/value rows shared by text and Markdown rendering.

nodes.name: renderFileText
nodes.summary: Renders a single file's Atlas entry, key functions, and computed links as text.

nodes.name: renderAtlasText
nodes.summary: Renders the Atlas as indented terminal text, folders first, then files and key functions.

nodes.name: renderAtlasMarkdown
nodes.summary: Renders the Atlas as a Markdown document suitable for reading or committing.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Local, free stem-based search of the Atlas that ranks files and symbols against a goal, weighting name matches over entry matches and favouring unpractised code.

nodes.name: words
nodes.summary: Splits text, paths, or names (camelCase and snake_case) into lowercase word stems.

nodes.name: searchAtlas
nodes.summary: Ranks files and symbols against a goal by stem matches, weighting names over entries and favouring functions and unpractised code.

nodes.name: targetOf
nodes.summary: Formats a search result as a `file#symbol` target for fiu drill, kata, or predict.

nodes.name: skeleton.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the Atlas skeleton: the drillable source files, their symbols and git blob hashes, and the folder tree, plus scope resolution for folder arguments.

nodes.name: blobHash
nodes.summary: Computes git's blob hash of file content so descriptions match identical content across clones.

nodes.name: buildSkeleton
nodes.summary: Builds the Atlas structure: drillable files, their symbols and hashes, and the folders holding them.

nodes.name: skeletonFile
nodes.summary: Builds one skeleton file record with its hash, symbols, and key functions.

nodes.name: foldersBottomUp
nodes.summary: Lists folders under a scope deepest first, the order they are described in.

nodes.name: atlasScope
nodes.summary: Resolves a folder argument to a repository-relative scope path, rejecting unknown targets.

nodes.name: AtlasTargetError
nodes.summary: Error raised when an Atlas path argument does not name a known folder or file.

nodes.name: store.ts
nodes.summary: Zod-validated persistence for the Atlas JSON file with entry staleness tracking, folder work planning, and merge policies for sharing and fetching Atlases.

nodes.name: emptyAtlas
nodes.summary: Creates an empty version-1 Atlas.

nodes.name: readAtlas
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the Atlas file, returning an empty Atlas when absent.

nodes.name: ownEntries
nodes.summary: Filters an Atlas to only entries Fiu itself wrote, never those from another tool.

nodes.name: writeAtlas
nodes.summary: Writes Fiu's own Atlas entries to disk.

nodes.name: entryState
nodes.summary: Classifies an entry as missing, stale, or current against a content hash.

nodes.name: folderWork
nodes.summary: Determines which files and whether the folder entry itself need describing in a build.

nodes.name: staleCounts
nodes.summary: Counts described files and folders with stale entries.

nodes.name: mergeAtlas
nodes.summary: Merges two Atlases entry by entry with a pick policy, reporting how many entries came from the incoming side.

nodes.name: preferOursOrNewer
nodes.summary: Merge policy for sharing: the sharer's entry wins for identical content, otherwise the newer one.

nodes.name: preferCurrent
nodes.summary: Merge policy for fetching: keep the local entry unless the fetched one describes the code as it currently is.

nodes.name: symbols.ts
nodes.summary: Language-agnostic regex-based symbol extraction that finds declarations and their extents in source files and selects each file's densest key functions.

nodes.name: extractSymbols
nodes.summary: Extracts declared symbols (functions, classes, methods) with line extents from source using built-in or custom patterns.

nodes.name: keyFunctions
nodes.summary: Selects a file's densest callables above a minimum length, excluding constructors.

nodes.name: endOf
nodes.summary: Finds where a declaration ends via brace matching or indentation, never past the next sibling declaration.

nodes.name: ua.ts
nodes.summary: The only module that understands Understand-Anything's knowledge-graph format: finds and reads the graph, resolves nodes against Fiu's skeleton, and judges each entry's freshness by blob hash.

nodes.name: findUaDir
nodes.summary: Locates Understand-Anything's graph directory in the repository, if any.

nodes.name: readForeignAtlas
nodes.summary: Reads UA's knowledge graph and resolves it against today's skeleton without ever throwing for the graph's sake.

nodes.name: resolveGraph
nodes.summary: Pure resolution of UA graph nodes, layers, and tour steps into per-file and per-symbol foreign Atlas entries.

nodes.name: foreignState
nodes.summary: Judges a UA entry current when the file's blob hash matches what UA analysed, stale otherwise.

nodes.name: symbolOf
nodes.summary: Maps a UA function/class node to the skeleton's symbol name, ignoring ambiguous names.

nodes.name: firstSentence
nodes.summary: Extracts a description's first sentence on one line within the Atlas length limit.

nodes.name: blobHashesAt
nodes.summary: Lists every file's blob hash at a commit via git, or undefined when the commit is absent.

nodes.name: commits.ts
nodes.summary: Reads git commit info, detects AI-co-authored commits and in-progress git operations, and picks the single best drillable file changed by a commit.

nodes.name: isAiAuthored
nodes.summary: Detects whether a commit message carries a Co-Authored-By trailer from an AI coding assistant.

nodes.name: readCommit
nodes.summary: Reads a commit's sha, subject, author, parents, and AI-authorship flag.

nodes.name: operationInProgress
nodes.summary: Reports a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or revert in progress in the repository.

nodes.name: chooseTarget
nodes.summary: Chooses at most one drillable file per commit: the recognised source file with the most changed lines.

nodes.name: atlas.ts
nodes.summary: CLI handlers for `fiu atlas`: viewing the Atlas, local search, and building descriptions bottom-up via model calls after a cost estimate and confirmation.

nodes.name: planAtlasCalls
nodes.summary: Plans every model call a build of a scope makes, deepest folders first, batching files.

nodes.name: estimateAtlasCost
nodes.summary: Estimates an Atlas build's token usage and cost from prompt sizes and model prices.

nodes.name: buildAtlas
nodes.summary: `fiu atlas build`: describes missing or stale Atlas entries bottom-up after a cost confirmation, honouring UA coverage.

nodes.name: searchAtlasCommand
nodes.summary: `fiu atlas search`: lists files and symbols for a goal with each one's map state.

nodes.name: atlasView
nodes.summary: `fiu atlas [<path>]`: shows the Atlas for the repository, a folder, or a single file with links.

nodes.name: plan.ts
nodes.summary: Plans a learning Track for `fiu explore`: chooses allowed Workout kinds, builds the planning prompt enriched with Atlas entries, calls the model, and validates the plan.

nodes.name: trackKinds
nodes.summary: Determines which Workout kinds a Track may use from overrides or user preferences.

nodes.name: trackRules
nodes.summary: Rules for ordering a Track, shared by Fiu's planner and agent mode's prepare_track.

nodes.name: candidatesPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user prompt listing a module's shortlisted candidate files.

nodes.name: withAtlas
nodes.summary: Annotates candidates with Atlas descriptions of each file and its key functions.

nodes.name: checkPlan
nodes.summary: Validates a Track plan against the shortlist and allowed kinds.

nodes.name: planTrack
nodes.summary: Makes one inexpensive model call (plus a retry) that picks and orders a Track's steps.

nodes.name: shortlist.ts
nodes.summary: Shortlists a module's most logic-dense source files using a branching-per-line logic score shared by `fiu explore` and `fiu map`.

nodes.name: branchCount
nodes.summary: Counts branching constructs in source text.

nodes.name: shortlist
nodes.summary: Returns a module's most logic-dense drillable source files, densest first.

nodes.name: logicScore
nodes.summary: Scores a file's logic density as branching per line, favouring bigger files; undefined for files too short or too long.

nodes.name: repoRelativeDir
nodes.summary: Converts a directory to a POSIX repository-relative path.

nodes.name: ExploreTargetError
nodes.summary: Error raised when an explore target module is invalid.

nodes.name: builtin.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the built-in Language Profiles for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Go: file extensions, test commands, result formats, and import styles.

nodes.name: parsers.ts
nodes.summary: Parsers that turn test-runner output (TAP from node --test, go test -json, Python unittest verbose, JUnit XML) into uniform test results.

nodes.name: parseTap
nodes.summary: Parses TAP 13 output from node --test into named leaf test results.

nodes.name: yamlBlock
nodes.summary: Parses the YAML diagnostic block following a TAP result line, including block scalars.

nodes.name: parseGoJson
nodes.summary: Parses go test -json events into leaf test results, mapping panics to errors.

nodes.name: parseUnittestVerbose
nodes.summary: Parses Python unittest verbose output, taking outcomes from FAIL/ERROR report blocks.

nodes.name: trimPythonTraceback
nodes.summary: Trims a Python traceback to frames in the Workout's own files.

nodes.name: parseJunitXml
nodes.summary: Parses JUnit XML into results, treating failure as assertion failure and error as error.

nodes.name: paths.ts
nodes.summary: Path filter that excludes tests and generated or vendored code from what is considered drillable source.

nodes.name: isDrillableSourcePath
nodes.summary: True for a repository path that is not a test or generated/vendored file.

nodes.name: profile.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions and Zod schema for Language Profiles: everything Fiu needs to build and run Workouts in one language, as pure data.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses z.infer to derive the UserProfile type from its Zod schema, keeping runtime validation and static types in sync.

nodes.name: registry.ts
nodes.summary: Registry merging built-in Language Profiles with repo- and user-declared ones, and resolving the profile for a given source file.

nodes.name: profiles
nodes.summary: Combines built-in profiles with repo and user declared ones, later declarations winning by id and extension.

nodes.name: profileForFile
nodes.summary: Resolves the Language Profile for a source file by extension, throwing when unsupported.

nodes.name: UnsupportedLanguageError
nodes.summary: Error raised when no Language Profile recognises a file.

nodes.name: map.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `fiu map`: computes a developer's comprehension debt by directory from git history, AI-authored changes, practice Attempts, and logic scores, with next-step suggestions.

nodes.name: buildMap
nodes.summary: `fiu map`: builds per-directory comprehension debt from git history, Attempts, AI changes, and logic scores.

nodes.name: practiceByFile
nodes.summary: Maps each source file to the latest finished Attempt on a Workout made from it and that Workout's commit.

nodes.name: recentlyAiChanged
nodes.summary: Collects files touched by AI-authored commits in recent days.

nodes.name: changedSince
nodes.summary: Counts lines changed in a file since a commit, or undefined if unknown.

nodes.name: groupByDirectory
nodes.summary: Groups file entries into directory summaries.

nodes.name: suggest
nodes.summary: Produces up to three next-step suggestions from directory debt.

nodes.name: render.ts
nodes.summary: Formats a Workout test run session result for the terminal, with pass/fail marks, trimmed messages, and output tails.

nodes.name: formatRun
nodes.summary: Formats a session run's verdict and test results for the terminal.

nodes.name: prompt.ts
nodes.summary: System and user prompts for Workout synthesis: rules for Drills, Katas, Predictions, Diagnoses, and Prediction Series, plus retry prompts.

nodes.name: drillSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: System prompt with rules for synthesising a Drill (a minimal planted bug with regression test).

nodes.name: kataSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: System prompt for a Kata: rebuild a missing piece of logic from its contract and tests.

nodes.name: predictionSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: System prompt for Predictions and What-ifs about system behaviour, for non-code readers.

nodes.name: diagnosisSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: System prompt for a Diagnosis: pick the Cause explaining a practice incident.

nodes.name: seriesRules
nodes.summary: Rules appended for a Prediction Series of a given number of questions.

nodes.name: seriesRetryPrompt
nodes.summary: Retry prompt for a Series reporting feedback and how many questions remain needed.

nodes.name: systemPromptFor
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the system prompt for a Workout kind.

nodes.name: drillUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the user prompt carrying the target source, pinned symbol, and triggering commit.

nodes.name: retryPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds a retry prompt from gate feedback for a Workout kind.

nodes.name: context.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the 'Around this code' context section for a Workout from Atlas entries and links, while checking descriptions never leak the answer or the changed code.

nodes.name: otherVersions
nodes.summary: Collects a Workout's alternative code versions (bugged, gapped, or Variants).

nodes.name: answerTexts
nodes.summary: Extracts the true and wrong option or Cause texts of a Prediction or Diagnosis.

nodes.name: aroundThisCode
nodes.summary: Builds the 'Around this code' section from Atlas entries and links, filtering any description that leaks the answer.

nodes.name: targetNames
nodes.summary: Names the target: the pinned symbol and every function containing changed or removed lines.

nodes.name: distinctiveTokens
nodes.summary: Finds identifiers, numbers, and strings only the changed lines contain, which descriptions must not reveal.

nodes.name: answerPicker
nodes.summary: Predicate that flags descriptions using words only the true answer uses.

nodes.name: leakChecker
nodes.summary: Predicate that flags descriptions naming the target or distinctive changed-line tokens.

nodes.name: debrief.ts
nodes.summary: Builds and renders the post-Attempt Debrief: what the target code is for, who calls it, tension signals from links, and which neighbours to practise next.

nodes.name: buildDebrief
nodes.summary: Computes the Debrief from today's code, Atlas, and links: target descriptions, callers, signals, and try-next suggestions.

nodes.name: findTarget
nodes.summary: Finds the functions a Workout is about from where its versions differ, falling back to the pinned symbol.

nodes.name: renderDebriefText
nodes.summary: Renders the Debrief for the terminal.

nodes.name: renderDebriefMarkdown
nodes.summary: Renders the Debrief as debrief.md in the Attempt directory.

nodes.name: auto.ts
nodes.summary: Manages Fiu's background generation: installs, migrates, and removes a marked post-commit hook block, toggles the `auto` setting in config, reports caps and status, and gates enabling on consent.

nodes.name: hookBlock
nodes.summary: Builds the marked shell block that runs `fiu refill --background --commit` from the post-commit hook.

nodes.name: installHook
nodes.summary: Installs or refreshes Fiu's marked block in .git/hooks/post-commit without touching the user's own lines.

nodes.name: removeHook
nodes.summary: Removes exactly Fiu's hook block, deleting the hook file only if Fiu created it and it is now empty.

nodes.name: migrateLegacyHook
nodes.summary: Replaces a post-commit hook block written under a former project name with Fiu's block.

nodes.name: hookInstalled
nodes.summary: Reports whether Fiu's post-commit hook block is present.

nodes.name: setAuto
nodes.summary: Turns background generation on or off in .fiu/config.json while preserving other settings.

nodes.name: autoCaps
nodes.summary: Resolves the background-generation caps in force from config over defaults.

nodes.name: autoStatus
nodes.summary: Summarizes background generation state: enabled, hook installed, caps, and whether the queue is full.

nodes.name: enableAuto
nodes.summary: Enables background generation after obtaining consent, writing config and installing the hook.

nodes.name: AutoConsentRequiredError
nodes.summary: Error thrown when enabling background generation needs user consent that was not given.

nodes.name: log.ts
nodes.summary: Append-only JSON-lines log of what `fiu refill` did with each commit, with readers and a summary of unseen failures for the user.

nodes.name: logPath
nodes.summary: Returns the path of the workspace's background log file.

nodes.name: appendLog
nodes.summary: Appends one JSON entry to .fiu/log.

nodes.name: readLog
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the background log, tolerating malformed lines.

nodes.name: unseenFailureSummary
nodes.summary: Summarizes background generation failures the user has not yet seen.

nodes.name: cli.ts
nodes.summary: Commander-based entry point for the `fiu` CLI, wiring every subcommand (init, drill, kata, predict, diagnose, train, quick, track, share, atlas, auto, cost, stats, discard/restore) to the command modules and terminal UI.

nodes.name: generationCommand
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a Commander subcommand for a Workout kind (drill, kata, predict, diagnose) with shared options.

nodes.name: runTrack
nodes.summary: Runs track listing or continuation for the `fiu track` command.

nodes.name: runRefill
nodes.summary: Action for `fiu refill`: tops up the Workout queue, logging and handling busy or background runs.

nodes.name: quickWhileCommand
nodes.summary: Starts the user's `--while` command in the background for `fiu quick --while`.

nodes.name: runTrain
nodes.summary: Action for `fiu train`: wires config, terminal IO, and options into the train session.

nodes.name: terminalUi
nodes.summary: Creates the terminal-backed IO and spinner used by interactive commands, closing it afterwards.

nodes.name: cost.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `fiu cost`: aggregates recorded API spend from Workouts and Attempts into monthly and per-model cost reports.

nodes.name: startOfMonth
nodes.summary: Returns the start of the current month used to bucket spend.

nodes.name: costReport
nodes.summary: Builds the `fiu cost` report of spend per month and model from recorded Workout and Attempt usage.

nodes.name: track.ts
nodes.summary: Implements `fiu track` listing and continuation: formats Track progress and resumes the next unfinished Workout of a Track through train.

nodes.name: formatProgress
nodes.summary: Formats a Track's progress as a short completed/total string.

nodes.name: trackListing
nodes.summary: Lists saved Tracks with their progress.

nodes.name: continueTrack
nodes.summary: Continues a Track by training its next unfinished Workout.

nodes.name: train.ts
nodes.summary: Core `fiu train` / `fiu quick` session logic: picks a Workout, opens an Attempt in a sandbox, reruns tests on every save, runs Prediction/Diagnosis/What-if reveals, shows the Debrief, and records outcomes.

nodes.name: quick
nodes.summary: `fiu quick`: jumps straight into the queue's best Quick Workout without prompts.

nodes.name: train
nodes.summary: `fiu train [id]`: selects a Workout, opens or resumes an Attempt, and runs the session to completion or pause.

nodes.name: runSession
nodes.summary: Main training loop: sandboxed test runs on each save, key handling, and dispatch to kind-specific flows.

nodes.name: closeAttempt
nodes.summary: Finishes an Attempt: source-bug question, Debrief, rating, and recorded outcome.

nodes.name: showDebrief
nodes.summary: Builds and displays the Debrief after an Attempt.

nodes.name: readAnswer
nodes.summary: Reads an option choice and confidence level from the keyboard for Predictions and Diagnoses.

nodes.name: runDiagnosis
nodes.summary: Runs a Diagnosis Workout: shows the incident, collects the chosen cause, and reveals the answer.

nodes.name: runPrediction
nodes.summary: Runs a Prediction Workout: shows the question and options, collects the answer, and reveals the outcome.

nodes.name: revealWhatIf
nodes.summary: Reveals the effect of a What-if change after the human answers.

nodes.name: describeDefect
nodes.summary: Describes a Workout's injected defect in human-readable form.

nodes.name: readKeys
nodes.summary: Reads keypresses during a session and maps them to actions.

nodes.name: quickWhile
nodes.summary: `fiu quick --while`: practises Quick Workouts while the user's command runs in the background.

nodes.name: UnknownProfileError
nodes.summary: Error for a Workout whose language profile is not recognized.

nodes.name: prices.ts
nodes.summary: Built-in per-model token price table with a zod schema and a lookup helper used for cost estimation.

nodes.name: priceFor
nodes.summary: Looks up the token price for a model, falling back to configured overrides.

nodes.name: usage.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes LLM token usage, merges it by model, and estimates and formats the USD cost of generation calls.

nodes.name: usageOf
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized token usage from an LLM response.

nodes.name: mergeByModel
nodes.summary: Sums token usage per model.

nodes.name: estimateCost
nodes.summary: Estimates USD cost of usage using the price table.

nodes.name: totalTokens
nodes.summary: Totals input and output tokens of a usage record.

nodes.name: describeCost
nodes.summary: Formats usage and cost as a human-readable line.

nodes.name: formatUsd
nodes.summary: Formats a dollar amount for display.

nodes.name: tracks.ts
nodes.summary: Persists and loads Tracks (ordered sequences of Workouts) in the workspace, generates track ids, and computes progress through a Track.

nodes.name: tracksDir
nodes.summary: Returns the workspace directory holding Tracks.

nodes.name: saveTrack
nodes.summary: Writes a Track to the workspace as JSON.

nodes.name: listTracks
nodes.summary: Lists all saved Tracks.

nodes.name: loadTrack
nodes.summary: Loads a Track by id, throwing TrackNotFoundError if missing.

nodes.name: trackId
nodes.summary: Generates a unique id for a new Track.

nodes.name: trackProgress
nodes.summary: Computes which Workouts of a Track are done and which comes next.

nodes.name: TrackNotFoundError
nodes.summary: Error raised when a requested Track does not exist.

nodes.name: legacy.ts
nodes.summary: One-time migration from the project's former names (Fiutsu, Kintsugi): moves user config, the repository workspace, and the post-commit hook to Fiu's names.

nodes.name: migrateFromFormerNames
nodes.summary: Moves Fiutsu/Kintsugi config, workspace, and hook to Fiu's names without overwriting, returning notices.

nodes.name: render.ts
nodes.summary: Renders the text output of `fiu map` (practice coverage per file) and `fiu stats` (answer accuracy, calibration, and Blind Spots).

nodes.name: renderMap
nodes.summary: Renders the `fiu map` coverage view of practised files and directories.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Describes one map entry's practice counts.

nodes.name: command
nodes.summary: Suggests the next command to practise a map entry.

nodes.name: renderStats
nodes.summary: Renders `fiu stats`: accuracy, confidence calibration, trend, and Blind Spots.

nodes.name: stats.ts
nodes.summary: Computes answer statistics for Predictions and Diagnoses: first answers, accuracy by kind and directory, confidence calibration, recent trend, and Blind Spots.

nodes.name: firstAnswers
nodes.summary: Collects the first finished answer to every Prediction and Diagnosis, oldest first.

nodes.name: blindSpots
nodes.summary: Finds files whose latest first answer was certain and wrong.

nodes.name: answerStats
nodes.summary: Computes accuracy, per-kind and per-directory rates, calibration, and recent trend for `fiu stats`.

nodes.name: background.ts
nodes.summary: Runs the user's own slow command (`fiu quick --while`) in the background in its own process group, logging output and reporting its result and duration.

nodes.name: runInForeground
nodes.summary: Runs a command in the foreground when there is nothing to practise.

nodes.name: describeDuration
nodes.summary: Formats a duration for display.

nodes.name: describeResult
nodes.summary: Describes how a background command ended.

nodes.name: reportResult
nodes.summary: Prints a background command's result, with a log tail on failure.

nodes.name: BackgroundCommand
nodes.summary: Runs a user command in its own process group with output to a log, supporting elapsed time, tail, and graceful stop.

nodes.name: watch.ts
nodes.summary: File-system watcher that debounces save events and triggers test runs only when content fingerprints actually change.

nodes.name: watchForChanges
nodes.summary: Watches a directory and invokes a callback after a quiet period when content really changed.

nodes.name: contentFingerprint
nodes.summary: Hashes the contents of watched files to detect real changes.

nodes.name: git.ts
nodes.summary: Thin git plumbing wrappers for the shared-Workouts branch: fetching, reading trees and blobs, hashing, committing with a custom tree, and pushing.

nodes.name: fetchShared
nodes.summary: Fetches the shared Workouts branch from a remote.

nodes.name: readTree
nodes.summary: Lists entries of a git tree on the shared ref.

nodes.name: readBlob
nodes.summary: Reads a blob's contents from git.

nodes.name: hashFile
nodes.summary: Writes content to the git object store and returns its hash.

nodes.name: commitWith
nodes.summary: Creates a commit on the shared branch from a constructed tree.

nodes.name: pushShared
nodes.summary: Pushes the shared branch to the remote.

nodes.name: onSomeRemoteBranch
nodes.summary: Checks whether a commit is reachable from some remote branch.

nodes.name: gitIdentity
nodes.summary: Reads the user's git name and email.

nodes.name: SharingError
nodes.summary: Error type for failures in shared-branch git operations.

nodes.name: share.ts

nodes.name: moduleAbout

nodes.name: explore

nodes.name: init

nodes.name: config.ts

nodes.name: userConfigPath

nodes.name: userCacheDir

nodes.name: loadRepoConfig

nodes.name: loadUserConfig

nodes.name: resolveConfig

nodes.name: ConfigError

nodes.name: consent.ts

nodes.name: hasConsent

nodes.name: ConsentDeclinedError

nodes.name: credentials.ts

nodes.name: preflight

nodes.name: runRequest

nodes.name: ToolchainMissingError

nodes.name: canary.ts

nodes.name: runCanary
nodes.summary: Runs the canary probe inside the sandbox with a planted secret and reports every isolation guarantee that failed.

nodes.name: findFile
nodes.summary: Recursively finds a real file under a path up to a depth, for probing secret-directory read denial.

nodes.name: probeResourceLimits
nodes.summary: Proves memory and process-count limits are enforced under deliberately low limits, checking each probe stops for the right reason.

nodes.name: verifySandbox
nodes.summary: Throws SandboxUnavailableError unless the canary passes; caches passes per platform, Node and runtime version.

nodes.name: policy.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the sandbox filesystem policy (deny secret home paths and the repo, allow only listed writes) and a scrubbed allowlist environment so no secrets reach Workout code.

nodes.name: filesystemPolicy
nodes.summary: Builds deny/allow read and write lists: secrets and the repo unreadable, Workout and scratch directories writable.

nodes.name: scrubbedEnv
nodes.summary: Builds an empty environment plus an explicit allowlist (PATH, LANG, HOME, TMPDIR and profile extras).

nodes.name: process.ts
nodes.summary: Runs shell commands in their own process group under kernel rlimits plus a watchdog enforcing tree-wide memory and process totals, timeouts and output caps.

nodes.name: shellQuote
nodes.summary: Single-quotes a string for safe use in a shell command.

nodes.name: runProcess
nodes.summary: Spawns a bash command in its own process group with rlimits, a watchdog over the process tree's memory and count, a timeout, and capped output capture.

nodes.name: describeStop

nodes.name: processTree

nodes.name: userTaskCount

nodes.name: capture

nodes.name: sandbox.ts

nodes.name: SourceTooLargeError

nodes.name: expandSeries

nodes.name: checkDrillOutput

nodes.name: normaliseLine

nodes.name: diff.ts

nodes.summary: Computes line-level hunks of removed and added lines between two texts using a longest-common-subsequence approach.

nodes.name: checkReferencePasses
nodes.summary: Fails unless the tests ran and every test passes against the Reference Solution.

nodes.name: checkStartingCodeFails
nodes.summary: Fails unless the starting code makes at least one test fail by assertion.

nodes.name: checkRegressionTest
nodes.summary: Checks that the named regression test exists and fails against the Drill's starting code.

nodes.summary: Finds test results matching a given test name.

tour.title: What Fiu Is
tour.description: Start with the README, which introduces Fiu as a CLI that turns real repository code into small Verified exercises called Workouts, with editor-based Drills and Katas and terminal-based Predictions, What-ifs and Diagnoses. The GLOSSARY defines the ubiquitous language used everywhere in the code: the Workout kinds, the anatomy of a Workout, and progress terms such as Tracks. Keep these terms in mind, because module and type names map directly onto them.

tour.title: Specification and Build Setup
tour.description: SPEC.md is the full product specification: principles, CLI surface, Language Profiles, the Verified Gate, the OS sandbox and the LLM output schema, all of which reappear as modules later in this tour. package.json shows that Fiu is an ESM package exposing the `fiu` binary from dist/cli.js, built on commander, zod, the AI SDK, the MCP SDK and a sandbox runtime. The tsconfig files enable strict checking with NodeNext modules and compile only src into dist for publishing.
tour.languageLesson: With NodeNext module resolution, ESM TypeScript imports name files with explicit extensions. Here imports use `.ts` extensions that the compiler rewrites on emit, and 'erasable-only syntax' restricts the code to TypeScript features that can simply be stripped, so Node can also run the sources directly.

tour.title: The CLI Entry Point
tour.description: src/cli.ts is the commander-based entry point that wires every subcommand (init, drill, kata, predict, diagnose, train, quick, track, share, atlas, auto, cost, stats and more) to its command module. It is the root of the dependency graph: a breadth-first walk from it reaches almost the whole codebase. terminal.ts provides the real-terminal implementation of the train IO interface (raw-mode keys, pickers, prompts, editor launching), which keeps terminal handling separate from session logic.

tour.title: Workspace, Config and Consent
tour.description: These foundation modules are among the most imported files in the project. workspace.ts finds the git root and manages the `.fiu` directory layout, and config.ts merges repo-level settings (no secrets) with user-level settings that hold API keys. credentials.ts reads keys only from the environment or user config, never from the repository, and consent.ts records per-provider consent before any code is sent to an LLM. Together they set the privacy boundaries every command depends on.
tour.languageLesson: Zod schemas act as both runtime validators and TypeScript types: `z.infer<typeof Schema>` derives the static type from the schema, so a config file read from disk is checked against the same definition the compiler uses.

tour.title: Language Profiles
tour.description: Fiu supports several languages through Language Profiles, which are pure data describing file extensions, test commands, result formats and import styles. profile.ts defines the schema, builtin.ts declares TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and Go, and registry.ts merges them with repo- or user-declared profiles. run.ts runs a profile's toolchain and tests inside the sandbox, and parsers.ts normalises TAP, go test JSON, unittest and JUnit output into uniform results.

tour.title: The OS Sandbox
tour.description: Workout code is untrusted model output, so every test run goes through sandbox.ts, which gives each run a fresh scratch HOME and TMPDIR, a scrubbed environment and resource limits. policy.ts denies secret home paths and the repository itself, and process.ts enforces rlimits, timeouts and output caps on whole process groups. canary.ts proves isolation by running a probe that tries network access, outside writes and secret reads, and caches passing results.

tour.title: Generating a Workout
tour.description: commands/drill.ts implements `fiu drill`, `kata`, `predict` and `diagnose`: it resolves the target, checks consent, the API key, the sandbox and the toolchain from the previous steps, then hands off to generation. generate.ts is the shared generation entry point for both drill and refill and records all model spend whatever the outcome. synthesize.ts runs the core loop: prompt the model (built by model.ts across Anthropic, OpenAI and Google) for structured output, check the candidate, and feed failures back for limited retries.

tour.title: Schemas and the Verified Gate
tour.description: Fiu's central rule is that answers are measured by running code, never asserted by the model. schema.ts defines the Zod output schema for every Workout kind plus semantic checks that reject leaky or spoiler-laden output. gate.ts is the Verified gate: it runs each candidate's tests in fresh sandboxes and applies kind-specific checks such as 'reference passes, starting code fails' and minimal diffs. defect.ts makes sure an injected bug does not already exist in the real source, using the line diff from diff.ts.

tour.title: Storing Workouts and Attempts
tour.description: Once a Workout passes the gate, save.ts writes it to disk with its provenance, solution and kind-specific README. store.ts is the second-most-depended-on module after the workspace: it lists, loads, discards and restores Workouts and records outcomes and spend. attempts.ts manages Attempts, each a fresh copy of the Starting Code in `.fiu/attempts/`, so the original Workout stays untouched and can be redone or shared.

tour.title: Training Sessions
tour.description: commands/train.ts drives `fiu train` and `fiu quick`: it picks a Workout, opens an Attempt in the sandbox, reruns tests on every save, runs the reveal for terminal Workouts and shows the Debrief. session.ts holds the sitting's logic (verdicts, hints, answers, recording outcomes) independently of any terminal UI, which is why terminal.ts from Step 3 is a separate implementation. watch.ts debounces file saves using content fingerprints, and render.ts formats test results.
tour.languageLesson: Defining the IO as a TypeScript interface and injecting the real terminal implementation lets session logic be tested with a fake IO, a form of dependency inversion that structural typing makes cheap.

tour.title: Building the Atlas
tour.description: The Atlas is Fiu's map of the repository. skeleton.ts collects drillable source files, their symbols and git blob hashes, using the regex-based extractor in symbols.ts. links.ts computes model-free links from import graphs and git co-change history, describe.ts asks the model to describe folders bottom-up, and store.ts persists entries with staleness tracking based on content hashes.

tour.title: Around This Code and Debriefs
tour.description: The Atlas feeds what learners see around each Workout. context.ts builds the 'Around this code' README section from Atlas entries and links, and checks that descriptions never leak the answer. debrief.ts renders the post-Attempt Debrief: who calls the code, tension signals such as churn and co-change, and neighbours to practise next. ua.ts is the only module that reads Understand-Anything knowledge graphs, and overlay.ts places those entries beneath Fiu's own Atlas, so Fiu's entries take precedence.

tour.title: Tracks, Map and Stats
tour.description: `fiu explore` builds a Track, an ordered sequence of Workouts for a module. shortlist.ts picks the most logic-dense files, and plan.ts makes one planning call enriched with Atlas entries before every step is generated through the pipeline from Step 7. map.ts measures comprehension debt by directory from git history, AI-authored changes and past Attempts, while stats.ts computes accuracy, confidence calibration and Blind Spots for Predictions and Diagnoses.

tour.title: Background Refill and Sharing
tour.description: Fiu can practise new code automatically: auto.ts installs a post-commit hook, and refill.ts turns each commit into a Quick Workout under a per-repo lock with queue and daily caps. commits.ts detects AI-co-authored commits and picks the best drillable file changed. share.ts publishes Workouts, Tracks and optionally the Atlas to a shared git branch, and re-verifies teammates' fetched Workouts in the sandbox, so the Verified guarantee still holds for shared Workouts.

tour.title: Agent Mode via MCP
tour.description: Finally, Fiu can run inside a coding agent instead of calling a model itself. mcp.ts exposes Fiu's tools over the Model Context Protocol, and drills.ts lets the agent author Drills, Tracks and Atlas entries while Fiu supplies prompts and still runs every submission through the Verified gate and sandbox from Steps 6 and 8. install.ts writes the Claude skill and slash commands, and texts.ts centralises every agent-facing text.
